name: ZSO_SESSION_ATTENDEES
description: The session attendees table defines individual parties who have attended or may attend a Presentation Session.  An individual attending a session may, for example, be a Sales Cloud Contact, or a Sales Cloud Lead.  A session attendee will be eligible to give Session Feedback

columns.name: ATTENDEE_ID
columns.description: ID column: the uniquely identifying surrogate key value

columns.name: ATTENDEE_TYPE
columns.description: Discriminator column that identifies the type of Attendee

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: The party ID for the indicated type of Attendee.  For an Attendee Type of 'CONTACT', this will be the Contact Id

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NO
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
